pairs: Jesus ergo ante sex dies Paschæ venit Bethaniam,
Then six days before the Passover, Jesus went to Bethania,
And they made a dinner for him there.
Lazarus vero unus erat ex discumbentibus cum eo.
And truly, Lazarus was one of those who were sitting at table with him.
Maria ergo accepit libram unguenti nardi pistici pretiosi,
And then Mary took twelve ounces of pure spikenard ointment, very precious,
et unxit pedes Jesu, et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis:
and she anointed the feet of Jesus, and she wiped his feet with her hair.
et domus impleta est ex odore unguenti.
And the house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
Dixit ergo unus ex discipulis ejus,
who was soon to betray him, said,
Quare hoc unguentum non veniit trecentis denariis,
“Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii
non quia de egenis pertinebat ad eum, sed quia fur erat,
not out of concern for the needy, but because he was a thief and,
he used to carry what was put into it.
Sinite illam ut in diem sepulturæ meæ servet illud.
“Permit her, so that she may keep it against the day of my burial.
For the poor, you have with you always.
But me, you do always not have.”
Cognovit ergo turba multa ex Judæis quia illic est,
Now a great multitude of the Jews knew that he was in that place,
not so much because of Jesus,
but so that they might see Lazarus,
whom he had raised from the dead.
Cogitaverunt autem principes sacerdotum ut et Lazarum interficerent:
And the leaders of the priests planned to put Lazarus to death also.
quia multi propter illum abibant ex Judæis,
For many of the Jews, because of him,
were going away and were believing in Jesus.
turba multa quæ venerat ad diem festum,
the great crowd that had come to the feast day,
cum audissent quia venit Jesus Jerosolymam,
when they had heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
and they went ahead to meet him.
benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini,
Blessed is he who arrives in the name of the Lord,
And Jesus found a small donkey,
ecce rex tuus venit sedens super pullum asinæ.
Behold, your king arrives, sitting on the colt of a donkey.”
Hæc non cognoverunt discipuli ejus primum:
At first, his disciples did not realize these things.
tunc recordati sunt quia hæc erant scripta de eo,
then they remembered that these things were written about him,
and that these things happened to him.
And so the crowd that had been with him,
quæ erat cum eo quando Lazarum vocavit de monumento,
when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead,
Propterea et obviam venit ei turba:
Because of this, too, the crowd went out to meet him.
For they heard that he had accomplished this sign.
Therefore, the Pharisees said among themselves:
“Do you see that we are accomplishing nothing?
ecce mundus totus post eum abiit.
Behold, the entire world has gone after him.”
Erant autem quidam gentiles, ex his qui ascenderant ut adorarent in die festo.
Now there were certain Gentiles among those who went up so that they might worship on the feast day.
who was from Bethsaida of Galilee,
Andreas rursum et Philippus dixerunt Jesu.
But Jesus answered them by saying:
dicens: Venit hora, ut clarificetur Filius hominis.
“The hour arrives when the Son of man shall be glorified.
nisi granum frumenti cadens in terram,
unless the grain of wheat falls to the ground and dies,
et qui odit animam suam in hoc mundo,
And whoever hates his life in this world,
there too my minister shall be.
Sed propterea veni in horam hanc:
But it is for this reason that I came to this hour.
And then a voice came from heaven,
and I will glorify it again.”
which was standing near and had heard it,
said that it was like thunder.
Non propter me hæc vox venit,
Now is the judgment of the world.
nunc princeps hujus mundi ejicietur foras.
Now will the prince of this world be cast out.
Et ego, si exaltatus fuero a terra,
And when I have been lifted up from the earth,
I will draw all things to myself.”
signifying what kind of death he would die.)
And so how can you say,
‘The Son of man must be lifted up?’
Who is this Son of man?”
Walk while you have the Light,
so that the darkness may not overtake you.
But whoever walks in darkness does not know where is he going.
so that you may be sons of the Light.”
et abiit et abscondit se ab eis.
and then he went away and hid himself from them.
Cum autem tanta signa fecisset coram eis,
And although he had done such great signs in their presence,
they did not believe in him,
so that the word of the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled,
who has believed in our hearing?
et brachium Domini cui revelatum est?
And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
Because of this, they were not able to believe,
et induravit cor eorum ut non videant oculis,
and hardened their heart, so that they may not see with their eyes,
and be converted: and then I would heal them.”
Verumtamen et ex principibus multi crediderunt in eum:
Yet truly, many of the leaders also believed in him.
But because of the Pharisees, they did not confess him,
so that they would not be cast out of the synagogue.
Dilexerunt enim gloriam hominum magis quam gloriam Dei.
For they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.
sed in eum qui misit me.
but in him who sent me.
I have arrived as a light to the world,
ut omnis qui credit in me, in tenebris non maneat.
so that all who believe in me might not remain in darkness.
Et si quis audierit verba mea,
And if anyone has heard my words
non enim veni ut judicem mundum,
For I did not come so that I may judge the world,
but so that I may save the world.
Qui spernit me et non accipit verba mea,
and does not accept my words has one who judges him.
The word that I have spoken,
ille judicabit eum in novissimo die.
the same shall judge him on the last day.
Quia ego ex meipso non sum locutus,
For I am not speaking from myself,
but from the Father who sent me.
He gave a commandment to me as to what I should say
ipse mihi mandatum dedit quid dicam et quid loquar.
Et scio quia mandatum ejus vita æterna est:
And I know that his commandment is eternal life. Therefore,
just as the Father has said to me,
